description: Roll out supply-chain hardening across all build pipelines: SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation. Must: integrate Syft for SBOM generation in all CI pipelines, sign container images with Cosign, generate SLSA Level 3 provenance attestation, configure policy enforcement (reject unsigned images in production), and verify that all deployed images have valid signatures + SBOM. Risk factors: signing key management, CI pipeline performance impact from SBOM generation, policy enforcement blocking legitimate deployments. Tools available: Syft, Cosign, Rekor, Kyverno, GitHub Actions.
